messages:
Priya (CS Lead): Quick capture from today's ACME onboarding sync — they reported three pain points that touch product, docs, and infra. Posting verbatim quotes and suggested next steps for prioritization.

Tom (Product): thanks — can you paste exact quotes and any repro steps?

Priya (CS Lead): pasted below. Short list first: 1) Need per-route cost visibility in console; 2) Webhook retries are creating duplicates, unclear why; 3) KMS key rotation docs for private deployments are not confident enough. Customer asked for an ETA.

Priya (CS Lead): customer quotes: 
- "We get a monthly surprise — can't map bill spike to any route or model"
- "Our webhook consumer sometimes ack's but we never see an event id — retries then cause doubles"
- "Rotation steps for keys feel risky, we worry about accidental lockout in private mode"

Maya (Docs): can you share any logs or sample payloads? I can start a KB and a safe-rotation checklist.

Priya (CS Lead): webhook repro snippet they shared: 
```
POST /hooks/ingest 200 OK
Body: <empty>
Client log: "ack received, missing event_id"
Retries: 2 duplicates in ~10 minutes
```

Sam (Eng): that looks like our retry logic treats 200s as success regardless of body. Quick fix: add validation that requires event_id header or body field before marking consumed; medium change though. We could also add a debug header to responses to help trace.

zendesk-bot: New ticket created: ACME-1024 "Visibility: billing per-route + webhook retry dupes"

Tom (Product): assign @eng and @docs. Priya — how urgent is this for ACME? Any renewal impact?

Priya (CS Lead): ACME is early in their term but prioritizing platform stability — renewal green for now. They asked for a workaround within 7 business days; they'd like a longer-term fix on the roadmap. High expansion upside so we should move quickly.

Jorge (CS): noted for renewal ops — will flag to AMs if we can deliver a short mitigation.

Sam (Eng): quick mitigation ideas: 1) emit X-RWI-Trace in webhook responses so their SREs can correlate retries; 2) add a console toggle to enable strict webhook validation (reject 200-with-empty-body) as a beta setting. Small changes. Est: trace header = 1 dev-day, console toggle + backend validation = 3 dev-days. Deep retry model change = 2+ sprints.

Maya (Docs): I'll draft two pieces: "Webhook troubleshooting & safe retries" and "KMS rotation checklist for private deployments". ETA 3 business days for drafts.

Priya (CS Lead): customer requested an interim workaround — we suggested: enable verbose connector logging on their side + use manual exports for cost analysis. Shared exact commands in DM.

Sam (Eng): I'll open a quick PR to add X-RWI-Trace and a small log line when event_id missing. Will link PR here when ready.

sam/pr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/812 (WIP)

Tom (Product): I'll create a product backlog ticket, attach ACME quotes and business impact, label with cs:acme and cs:billing-visibility. Propose MVP scope: (A) per-route cost aggregation view for last 30/90 days (backend + frontend), (B) webhook diagnostics UI with recent request/response headers + replay guidance. Tentatively P2; bump to P1 if ACME escalates.

Priya (CS Lead): can we get an estimate by EOD Friday to share with ACME? They want an answer before their weekly steering meeting.

Sam (Eng): confirmed estimates above. Need infra help for long-window aggregation costs. Tagging infra.

infra-bot: Created INF-289 to research aggregation approach and storage/cost for per-route billing telemetry.

Tom (Product): syncing Thurs 10am to align on go/no-go for MVP.

Priya (CS Lead): meeting invite incoming. Action items: Tom — make backlog ticket; Sam — PR for trace header; Maya — KB drafts; Priya/Jorge — follow up with ACME and share workaround steps.

Jorge (CS): happy to run a quick demo for ACME with the workaround if they request.

Maya (Docs): will include KMS safe-rotation checklist and sample commands.

Priya (CS Lead): thanks everyone :thumbsup: — marking thread for follow-up. Please add any additional notes below.

Sam (Eng): added note — we may need an alternative storage plan for per-route metrics if INF-289 flags high costs. If so, propose a sampled view for older windows.

Priya (CS Lead): noted. Will update ACME after Thurs sync.

Tom (Product): will confirm EOD Fri on prioritization and scope.
